jobs.title: Android App Development Intern
jobs.description:
Android App Development Intern

**Company:** TechTomorrow  
**Location:** Remote – India  
**Duration:** 2 Months  
**Working Hours:** 2–6 hours per day  
**Stipend:** ₹2,000 – ₹10,000 (performance-based)  
**Experience:** Freshers and candidates with 0–1 year of experience

About TechTomorrow

TechTomorrow is a technology-driven organization focused on building innovative digital products, developing software solutions and providing practical industry-oriented opportunities to aspiring developers.

We are looking for passionate Android App Development Interns who have hands-on programming skills and want to contribute to real-world mobile application development projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop Android applications using Kotlin and Java.
* Build modern mobile interfaces using XML and Jetpack Compose.
* Work with Android Studio and Android SDK.
* Integrate REST APIs and third-party services.
* Implement Firebase authentication, databases and notifications.
* Work with MVVM architecture and clean coding practices.
* Debug, test and optimize Android applications.
* Collaborate with software developers on real-world projects.
* Maintain code quality and use Git and GitHub for collaboration.

Required Technical Skills

* Kotlin or Java programming.
* Android Studio and Android SDK.
* Android application lifecycle.
* XML Layouts or Jetpack Compose.
* REST API integration and JSON.
* Git and GitHub.
* Basic software development and debugging skills.
